wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 11-002 wires the eight-channel SFX allocator, the same-origin replacement rule, the priority eviction rule, and the stop/update order into a single frozen runtime artifact. The new wrapper at src/vanilla/channelAndPriorityRuntime.ts imports createChannelTable / findFreeChannel / findChannelByOrigin / findEvictableChannel / allocateChannel / stopChannel / stopSound / getOccupiedChannelCount from the read-only src/audio/channels.ts and exposes a frozen façade with a `playSound` helper that composes the four canonical S_StartSound branches (same-origin replace, free slot, evict lowest priority, drop). The channel table reference is mutable per-tic to match vanilla file-scope `channels[]`; the façade is frozen.
publicSurface: ChannelAndPriorityRuntime interface (evictBySameOrigin, occupiedCount, playSound, stopChannel, stopSound, table)
SfxPlayRequest interface (origin, priority, sfxId, handle?, pitch?)
crossPlanInventoryUpdates: src/audio/channels.ts: src_importer_count 4→5, test_importer_count 7→8 (channelAndPriorityRuntime.ts + its focused test)
